items.note: Mixed human-LLM-agent groups play a convention-formation (collaborative description) game with varied agent shares; the outcome is convergence and form of group conventions, not creativity of output under AI assistance, so the task is a coordination game rather than a creative task; human N not stated.

Novice designers complete two conceptual design tasks with or without text and image GenAI; abstract reports which design stages AI supports; search notes suggest N=20 split into ChatGPT, Midjourney, combined and human-only groups, likely below the 50-person threshold.

CHI system paper comparing ChatScratch (storyboards, image generation, LLM coding help) with plain Scratch for children aged 6-12; claims higher-quality projects, but N, assignment, and how project quality or creativity was scored are not in the abstract.

Teaching experiment on a multimodal GenAI-supported college English creative writing model, with writing samples and questionnaires; reports better creative expression and writing quality, but the comparison group, N, and assignment are not stated (Research Square preprint).

Design ideation experiment comparing human-only groups with human-GenAI groups on text and image ideation exercises, assessing quality and quantity of ideas in divergent and convergent phases; N and assignment not stated (SSRN working paper).

Quasi-experiment with 45 Taiwanese university students in an art course; both groups use ChatGPT for digital storytelling and the treatment adds mind mapping, so the contrast is a pedagogy around AI rather than AI versus no AI; scored DS project performance plus creative-thinking tendency scales; below 50 participants.

Pilot with 29 participants solving an ethical dilemma under AI-prohibited, AI-optional, or AI-mandatory conditions; blind coders score perspective and counterargument diversity; the task is ethical reasoning rather than a standard creative task, assignment not stated, and N is below 50.

HCI system paper (IdeaBlocks) with a comparative study (N=12) against a baseline generative image tool, measuring images explored and visual diversity; AI-configuration contrast only, likely within-person, far below 50; also a formative study (N=7) and deployment (N=6); DIS 2026 version of arXiv 2507.22163.

Pilot RCT: 24 college students randomly assigned to write a short essay with no, limited, or unlimited LLM access; essay quality similar across groups, unlimited-access essays more similar to LLM output; below 50 participants; BEA 2026 version of arXiv 2606.00250.

Two high-school classes (31 with GenAI drawing mode, 29 with conventional drawing) in an ancient poetry course; outcomes are learning achievement and creativity (possibly a trait measure used as a moderator), with descriptive content analysis of drawings; class-level non-random assignment.
